description: The upstream, code-blind ANSSI EBIOS Risk Manager study author (deliberate sibling of rmf-sl) that authors each *-ebios-report.md's W1–W4 (W5 treatment/acceptance is the risk owner's terminus, fed by frama-c-monitoring verdicts — not authored in this loop). A soft-side, human-terminus loop: its lower bound is the ebios-lint.sh structural linter PLUS a human terminus (a disjoint completeness/realism reviewer + the risk owner), because content realism has no machine oracle. Dominant coherent-and-wrong: a fluent, well-chained but threat-wrong report whose scenarios were quietly read off the implementation (collapsing the exogeneity that makes it a valid upper bound for the verification loops), or a structurally-clean report that misses/under-rates a real strategic/operational scenario.

sources.name: EBIOS RM / ANSSI doctrine (the five workshops, severity/likelihood/acceptability scales, chaining rules, vocabulary)
sources.notes: Published ANSSI standard transcribed, never read off the code (terrain A). Adversarial-centric — NO all-origins (ADV/ACC/ENV) mandate, unlike RMF's 800-30 C6 check.

sources.name: Mission, scope, threat model + threat intel + ecosystem
External attack catalog — MITRE ATT&CK (gold)
sources.notes: Reviewer-only gold authority for an independent completeness enumeration.

sources.name: ebios-lint.sh structural / coverage / endogeneity linter (W1–W5 workshop-home + chaining/coverage + endogeneity tripwire)
sources.notes: Checks W1–W5 STRUCTURE (each clause has a workshop home, incl. W5's), coverage chaining, and the endogeneity tripwire ONLY — explicitly NOT realism. PARTIAL on W5: the W5 R# risk-level band (severity × likelihood) is not yet mechanized ('future' per report-format.md); 'W1–W5 structure' = workshop homes present, not full W5 grading.

sources.name: The W1–W4 EBIOS study the author produces (*-ebios-report.md; W5 treatment/acceptance added at the risk-owner terminus)
Scenario author's private rationale
sources.notes: A judge (reviewer) must never read it.

sources.name: Independent completeness + realism critique and verdicts
Risk owner acceptance/refusal of residual risk; W5 treatment sign-off
The implementation source / codebase under study
sources.notes: The load-bearing barrier: every content actor is barriered from this (author ⊥ code). Reading it collapses the study to endogenous self-certification.

sources.name: The downstream verification scope map (from frama-c-launch)
sources.notes: Enters from the downstream loop; barriered from the author so the study stays exogenous.

sources.name: One design/method claim under test (per probe)
sources.notes: A question posed to the loop, not authored by the probe — keeps the probe non-self-certifying; probe ids stay distinct from the reviewer's.

sources.name: One recorded probe verdict (linter's actual behaviour)

actors.name: EBIOS coordinator
actors.builds: Framing (object/goal → workshop subset via the adaptation table), sequencing, Gate-A, gap adjudication, the handoff to frama-c-launch
forbidden_moves: declare done on an author's say-so

actors.name: Scenario author (risk analyst)
actors.builds: W1–W4 from the mission + threat intel + ecosystem + the EBIOS corpus

upper_bound.text: The mission + threat model + EBIOS doctrine

lower_bound.text: EBIOS structural conformance (each clause has a workshop home)

forbidden_moves: READ THE IMPLEMENTATION SOURCE (the load-bearing exogeneity barrier)

upper_bound.text: EBIOS doctrine + mission + (if available) an external attack catalog (MITRE ATT&CK) as gold

lower_bound.text: The coverage linter + its OWN independent enumeration (the enumeration is the reviewer's method; the linter is the immutable oracle that squeezes it)

actors.name: Risk owner (the human terminus)
actors.builds: Acceptance/refusal of residual risk; W5 treatment sign-off

lower_bound.text: Consults the report + the reviewer's verdicts, then renders a HUMAN acceptance decision — no executable oracle
lower_bound.absent_reason: no executable oracle can settle acceptance/realism — the risk owner consults the report and the reviewer's verdicts as text, but renders a human acceptance decision; that absence of an oracle is why the risk owner is the terminus (the disjoint base)

disjointness.rationale: Every content actor (coordinator, author, reviewer) is barriered from the implementation, so none can read scenarios off the code; the author holds the mission+doctrine (never the reviewer's critique or the scope map), the reviewer holds doctrine+mission+an external gold catalog and its own enumeration (never the author's rationale or the code), and the risk owner holds the org's risk appetite (never authors the scenarios it accepts). No single pair certifies the report: structure is the linter's, realism is the reviewer's, acceptance is the risk owner's.
disjointness.load_bearing_barrier: author ⊥ code — the exogeneity invariant. If any content actor read the implementation, the EBIOS study collapses to endogenous self-certification and is no longer a valid upper bound for the verification loops.

catchability.blind_spot: misses / under-rates / code-mirrors a strategic or operational scenario; vacuous coverage
catchability.via: the reviewer's independent enumeration + the ebios-lint endogeneity tripwire
the risk-owner terminus refuses to accept on say-so

catchability.blind_spot: the reviewer itself rubber-stamps or misses a class
catchability.via: the risk owner weighs residual risk against the org's appetite and can refuse acceptance
org governance / external audit oversight (outside this loop)

catchability.blind_spot: mis-reads the tool's behaviour / over-generalizes one experiment
catchability.via: the coordinator adjudicates probe verdicts at Gate-A; the probe never fixes, only records

disjointness.terminus: Risk owner (human) for acceptance; the disjoint completeness/realism reviewer for realism — no executable oracle settles either.
